code.description:
Specifies the type of error reported. Possible values:

* "error" - General error
* "validation_error" - Validation error
* "not_found_error" - Resource not found
* "auth_error" - Authentication error
* "perm_error" - Permission error
* "sync_error" - Error occurred syncing settings with a Filer.
* "throttled_error" - The request was throttled; too many sent within a duration.

FilerFTPClients.description: A description of a Filer's connected FTP clients.

comment.description: Any comments regarding the FTP directory.

readonly.description: If true, users cannot change the contents of the directory.

visibility.description:
Controls what files and directories users can see.
* "default" - Every file is visible to user, even if user does not have access permissions. * "hide" - Users only see files they have permission to access. * "invisible" - No files are visible to user. If user has filename and permission, user can access file.

allow_from.description:
Comma-separated list of IP addresses or subnet addresses of hosts
allowed to access FTP directory. If blank, all hosts on your
network have access. This feature cannot be used in conjunction
with Users/Groups restrictions.

allow_users.description: The users that will be allowed to access the FTP directory.

allow_groups.description: The groups that will be allowed to access the FTP directory.

anonymous.description: If true, allow anonymous FTP access.

anonymous_only.description:
If true, only the anonymous user will be granted access. This feature
cannot be used in conjunction with IP address restrictions.

umask.description:
Normally, newly created files and directories have read and write
access for the owner, groups and other users. This option allows
you to restrict read and write access for groups or others.

* '000' - No Extra Restrictions (Default)
* '002' - Read-Only Others
* '022' - Read-Only Groups and Others
* '006' - Restrict Others
* '066' - Restrict Groups and Others
* '026' - Read-Only Groups, Restrict Others

hide_ownership.description:
All directory listings will show owner and group information as "ftp",
hiding the underlying owner and group. This may also be used to work
around directory listing issues on some non-interactive clients.

hidden_stores.description:
File uploads are done in two steps using a temporary file. This prevents
issues with incomplete uploads and file use before upload is complete.
This feature prevents resuming uploads. This is automatically enabled for
anonymous uploads.

field.description: The field to which the validation error applies, or "__all__" if it is a non-field error.

method.description: HTTP method to use on the link.

build.description: Current version and build number of the Filer's software.

guid.description: Unique identifier of the Filer instance.

management_state.description:
Current NMC Management state of the Filer. Possible values:

* 'self' - Filer is NOT managed by NMC.
* 'nmc' -  Filer is managed by NMC.
* 'pending_self' - Filer is pending self management.
* 'pending_nmc' - Filer is pending NMC management.

cpu_enabled.description: If true, will enable alerts for CPU usage.

cpu_threshold.description: Percentage of CPU usage that can trigger an alert.

cpu_duration.description: Time in minutes that the system will allow CPU usage over the cpu_threshold before trigging an alert.

cpu_alert_settings.description: Configuration values for alerting on Filer CPU usage.

memory_enabled.description: If true, will enable alerts for memory usage.

memory_threshold.description: Percentage of memory usage that can trigger and alert.

memory_duration.description: Time in minutes that the system will allow memory usage over the memory_threshold before trigging an alert.

memory_alert_settings.description: Configuration values for alerting on Filer memory usage.

snapshot_enabled.description: If true, will enable alerts for snapshots.

snapshot_duration.description: Time in hours to trigger an alert if a snapshot has not completed.

snapshot_alert_settings.description: Configuration values for alerting on Snapshots.

reserved.description: Set the percentage of the cache reserved for new, incoming data. A string representing a multiple-of-five integer between 5-90, or the string "unset" if the Filer automatically manages this.

maxv.description: Read only. Maximum percentage of the cache reserved for new, incoming data.

minv.description: Read only. Minimum percentage of the cache reserved for new, incoming data.

degrade_to_read_locks.description: Set whether or not to degrade all locks to read locks. Enabling this feature will cause all locks that are not read locks to be denied. This feature should only be enabled if the lock server is not available for an extended period of time. This feature effectively makes any directories with global locks enabled read only.

gl_settings.description: Settings that control certain aspects of Global Locking.

days.description: Days of the week to apply the QoS rule.

start.description: Hour of the day (0-23) to start applying the QoS rule.

stop.description: Hour of the day (0-23) to stop applying the QoS rule.

limit.description: The maximum outbound data rate in bytes. Specify zero for no limit.

ingress_limit.description: The maximum inbound data rate in bytes. Specify zero for no limit.

v2_enabled.description: If true, will enable v1,v2c support.

v3_enabled.description: If true, will enable v3 support.

v3_password.description: Password for SNMP v3 authentication. SHA authentication and optional privileged security using AES encryption are used to communicate to the SNMP agent. Will display a masked value of '*****' if a password exists, otherwise will be blank.

trap_ips.description: List of IPs or hostnames listening for SNMP traps. Leave blank if you wish not to listen for SNMP traps. Traps will be sent using SNMP v3 settings above and the Filer's unique engine id.

items.description: IPs or hostnames listening for SNMP traps.

current_time_utc.description: Current time reported by the Filer. Last report time will only be updated periodically unless manually refreshed.

settings.description: Settings that are associated with this Filer.

offline.description: If true, the Filer has not reported back to the NMC within the last hour.

osversion.description: The version of the Operating System running on this filer.

updates_available.description: Indicates whether or not there are software updates available for the Filer.

current_version.description: The current version of the software running on this Filer.

new_version.description: If an update is available, this indicates the new version of the software which will be installed.

updates.description: Information about the current software version and the availability of updates.

uptime.description: Uptime of this Filer, in seconds.

FilerCIFSLocks.description: A description of the CIFS File Locks that CIFS clients have on this Filer's shares.

hour.description: Hour of the day to perform automatic updates. An integer between 0 and 23, with 0 = '12 AM', 1 = '1 AM', ... 23 = '11 PM'.

sun.description: Whether the Filer runs automatic updates on Sunday.

mon.description: Whether the Filer runs automatic updates on Monday.

tue.description: Whether the Filer runs automatic updates on Tuesday.

wed.description: Whether the Filer runs automatic updates on Wednesday.

thu.description: Whether the Filer runs automatic updates on Thursday.

fri.description: Whether the Filer runs automatic updates on Friday.

sat.description: Whether the Filer runs automatic updates on Saturday.

aio_support.description: Read only. Indicates whether Async IO is supported.

deny_access.description: Read only. Indicates whether denying a user access to a share is supported

fruit_support.description: Read only. Indicates whether Mac OS X Extensions are available.

proto_level.description:
Read only. Indicates the CIFS protocol level of the Filer.

* *SMB3* -- CIFS & SMB3 support.
* *SMB2* -- CIFS & SMB2 support.
* '' -- CIFS support.

restrict_anonymous.description: Set whether to restrict anonymous user access.

roundup_size.description:
Set the Allocation roundup size.
This rounds the file size on disk reported to clients. Disabled by
default, this should only be enabled when the system is being
accessed by older SMBv1 clients; otherwise, there may be a
performance impact.
May also affect file size reporting on some platforms.

* `` - Allocation roundup size is 1 MiB (default value for Filers older than version 9.0).
* `0` - Allocation roundup is disabled (default value for Filers version 9.0 and newer).
* `1048576` - Allocation roundup size is 1 MiB.

smb3.description: Read only. Indicates whether SMB3 is supported.

smb_encrypt.description: Read only. Indicates whether SMB Encryption is supported.

unix_ext.description: Set whether Enhanced Support for POSIX clients is enabled.

veto_files.description: Read only. Indicates whether blocking files is supported. This can be configured through Shares settings.

masq_address.description: Set the Masquerade address. This IP address is presented to the client instead of the local server's IP.

idle_timeout.description: Set the amount of time (in seconds) that a user can stay connected while idle before being disconnected.

anon_user.description: Set the username a user must log in with in order to access FTP directories anonymously. This field is case sensitive. (default: anonymous)

anon_group.description: Set the Group assigned to the Anonymous User for file permissions. Note: This does not give all members of this group anonymous access. (default: anonymous)

protocols.description: Read only. List of FTP protocols supported by the Filer.

sun.description: Whether the Filer runs automatic updates on Sunday.

mon.description: Whether the Filer runs automatic updates on Monday.

tue.description: Whether the Filer runs automatic updates on Tuesday.

wed.description: Whether the Filer runs automatic updates on Wednesday.

thu.description: Whether the Filer runs automatic updates on Thursday.

fri.description: Whether the Filer runs automatic updates on Friday.

sat.description: Whether the Filer runs automatic updates on Saturday.

days.description: Set the days of the week on which the reports should be generated, at the hour specified in "activation_hour".

activation_hour.description: Hour of the day to generate and send the quota report. An integer between 0 and 23, with 0 = '12 AM', 1 = '1 AM', ... 23 = '11 PM'.

admin_report.description: Set whether to generate the administrative report. This reports on all Directory Quota Violations, and is sent to the addresses set to receive email in Email Settings and Configurations.

user_report.description: Set whether to generate the user report. This reports on individual Directory Quota Violations and will be sent to the address specifed in the Quota or the owner of the directory, if available (CIFS/AD mode only).

threshold.description: Report on Quotas where the usage is at or above the specified percent of the limit.

platform_name.description: A description of the hardware platform this Filer runs on.

model.description: Human-readable description of the CPU model.

sockets.description: Number of CPU sockets currently used on this Filer's platform.

cores.description: Total number of CPU cores across all CPUs.

memory.description: A string representing an integer. The size in megabytes of the Filer's memory.

size.description: The size in bytes of the Filer's cache.

used.description: The amount in bytes of the Filer's cache currently in use.

dirty.description: The amount of data in bytes belonging to files currently marked as needing to be written to storage or re-read into the cache.

free.description: The amount in bytes of the Filer's cache currently available.

percent_used.description: The percentage of the cache currently in use, i.e. used/size.

FilerPlatform.description: Information about a Filer's platform, including hardware type and information about CPU, Memory, and cache.

limit_single_device.description: Set whether to restrict users to using a single mobile device. If true, each user account can only have one mobile device associated with it which is allowed to connect to Mobile Service. If false, each user account can have any number of mobile devices registered.

additional_api_port.description: If set, allow access to Mobile service on the specified port. Set to a valid port number 1-65535. Set to null to disable.

session_expiration_time.description: If set, users must reauthenticate after their session has expired. Enter a value in hours. If set to 0, the sessions never expire.

connected.description: Read only. Indicates if Nasuni Support is currently connected for Remote Support.

timeout.description: Set the timeout in seconds after which Remote Support is automatically disabled.

FilerServicesSupport.description: Enable or disable Remote Support, set the timeout before it is automatically disabled, and report if there is an active connection from Nasuni Support.

filer_serial_number.description: Identifier to the Filer the message is associated with.

description.description: Description of the intent of message.

code.description: A code identifying the intent of the message.

status.description:
Current status of the message.
* 'synced' - Message has been received by the Filer, and the Filer returned a success response. * 'pending' - Message is currently in transit. * 'failure' - Messages has been received by the Filer, but returned an error response.

expiration_time.description: Time a synced message will expire and be removed from the messages list.

response_time.description: Time a message response was received.

initiated_by.description: The username of the user who triggered the message, or '[console]' if triggered by the NMC itself.

links.description: Links to related resources, collections, and actions.

Message.description: The message object is used to track an action that we want the Filer to perform.

date.description: The date the notification was triggered.

priority.description: The priority level of the notification.

name.description:
A name describing the type of notification. Notifications registered to pre-7.11
filers will be coded as "UNKNOWN".

group.description: The group (category) the notification belongs to.

acknowledged.description: A flag indicating whether the notification has been acknowledged.

sticky.description: A flag indicating whether the notification is transient in the application UI.

urgent.description: A flag indicating whether the notification is urgent.

remoteid.description: The remote notification ID (if filer is not null).

links.description: Links to related resources, collections, and actions.

href.description: A link to the requested endpoint.

limit.description: The maximum number of items in a page.

next.description: A link to the next page of objects. The value will be null if there isn't one.

offset.description: The item number the page starts on.

previous.description: A link to the previous page of objects. The value will be null if there isn't one.

total.description: Total number of items available at the requested endpoint.

Paging.description: The paging object provides a container for a listing of objects, defining the start, end, and total size of the listing. Any endpoint that returns a list of items, will likely be wrapped in a paging object.

filer_serial_number.description: Unique identifier for the associated filer.

volume_guid.description: Unique identifier for the associated volume.

name.description: The name of the CIFS share.

readonly.description: If enabled, users can not change the contents of the share.

browseable.description: If enabled, this share will appear when browsing.

hosts_allow.description: Hosts allowed to access the share. IP addresses or IP address/netmask values separated by spaces. Blank allows all hosts

hide_unreadable.description: Files and folders that the user cannot access do not appear in folder listings.

enable_previous_vers.description: Allow users to view and restore files using the Previous Versions tab in Windows

case_sensitive.description: Files and folders are considered different if the case of letters in the name differs. (Enabling case sensitivity aids performance)

enable_snapshot_dirs.description: Allows clients to access the hidden snapshot directories, showing previous versions of the file system (requires enabling Snapshot Directory Access for the volume).

homedir_support.description:
When enabled, the target folder path for the share is automatically
appended with a folder named for the user. Possible values:

* 0 - Disable
* 2 - Enable

mobile.description: Enable desktop and/or mobile device support

shared_links_enabled.description: Allow creating shared links to Web Access.

link_force_password.description: Require passwords for all shared links.

link_allow_rw.description: Allow the user to create writable shared links to directories.

authall.description:
When true, all users will be allowed to create shared links.
When false, no user will have access to the shared links until a user,
or a group the user is a member of, is specified.

allow_groups_ro.description: Groups with read-only access to shared links.

allow_groups_rw.description: Groups with read-write access to shared links.

deny_groups.description: Groups denied access to shared links.

allow_users_ro.description: Users with read-only access to shared links.

allow_users_rw.description: Users with read-write access to shared links.

deny_users.description: Users denied access to shared links.

browser_access_settings.description: Settings that can be applied to web access.

aio_enabled.description: Asynchronous I/O. Enable concurrent read/write access per client connection.

veto_files.description:
Block files. Specify file or directory name patterns that the share will make both
invisible and inaccessible. Enter one pattern per line.
The wildcard characters '*' and '?' may be used to specify multiple files
or directories. The '/' character is not valid. Note: This feature can break compatibility with some clients.

fruit_enabled.description: Enhances share behavior, including SMB2 protocol support, for Mac OS X Clients when possible.

smb_encrypt.description: Control if clients are desired or required to use SMB encryption when connecting to the share. Includes SMB3 encryption for Windows clients. Empty string indicates that client usage of encryption is optional.

authall.description:
When true, all Users can authenticate. When false, only specific
Groups and Users can authenticate. In this situation, no user will
have access to the share until a user, or a group the user is a member of, is specified.

rw_groups.description: Groups with read-write access to the share.

ro_groups.description: Groups with read-only access to the share.

deny_groups.description: Groups to deny access to the share.

ro_users.description: Users with read-only access to the share.

rw_users.description: Users with read-write access to the share.

deny_users.description: Users to deny access to the share.

links.description: Links to related resources, collections, and actions.

filer_serial_number.description: Identifier to the Filer the volume was created on.

nmc_managed.description: Indicates if the volume is fully managed by the NMC.

permissions_policy.description:
Permission policy of the volume. Possible values:

* 'NTFS60' - NTFS Compatible Mode
* 'NTFSONLY710' - NTFS Exclusive Mode
* 'POSIX60' - POSIX Mixed Mode
* 'MODEBITS60' - UNIX/NFS Permissions Only Mode
* 'PUBLICMODE60' - Unauthenticated Access Mode

days.description: Days of the week the antivirus service will run.

check_files_immediately.description: If true, files will be checked as they are written (CIFS volumes only).

allday.description: If true, the antivirus service will run all day.

start.description: Hour of the day to start the antivirus service. An integer between 0 and 23, with 0 = '12 AM', 1 = '1 AM', ... 23 = '11 PM'.

stop.description: Hour of the day to stop the antivirus service. An integer between 0 and 23, with 0 = '12 AM', 1 = '1 AM', ... 23 = '11 PM'.

enabled.description: If true, remote access is enabled for the volume.

access_permissions.description:
The remote access permission for this volume applies to all other Nasuni Filers on your account.
A value of 'custom' allows providing access permissions per Nasuni Filer (see 'filer_access' property).

items.description: Apply volume remote access permissions for an individual Filer.

quota.description: Maximum volume capacity in gigabytes. Set to 0 for unlimited. Quotas are applied after each successful snapshot.

case_sensitive.description: If true, the volume is case-sensitive. CIFS-only volumes perform better when volume is case-insensitive (value of false).

retain.description:
Type of snapshot retention imposed. Possible values:

* 'INFINITE' - All snapshots
* 'BY_COUNT' - Set number of snapshots
* 'BY_AGE' - Snapshots within a range

dedupe.description: If true, deduplication is enabled. Deduplication is a data compression technique for eliminating duplicate copies of repeating data.

compression.description: If true, compression (via zlib) is enabled.

chunk_size.description: Chunk size in bytes for cloud I/O. Value of zero means the default value will be used.

name.description: Full name of the cloud provider.

location.description: Location/region the volume was created in.

authenticated_access.description: If true, the users must authenticate to access the volume. If false, the volume is publicly available to all users.

policy_label.description: Full name of the Authentication policy.

links.description: Links to related resources, collections, and actions.

connected.description: If true, the specified filer is connected to the volume.

links.description: Links to related resources, collections, and actions.

name.description: Display name for the volume on the specified filer.

type.description:
Type of Volume. Possible values:

* 'master' - This volume is owned by  this filer.
* 'remote' - This volume is remote, relative to this filer.

days.description: Days of the week to perform syncs.

allday.description: If true, will sync all day.

start.description: Hour of the day to start the sync. An integer between 0 and 23, with 0 = '12 AM', 1 = '1 AM', ... 23 = '11 PM'.

stop.description: Hour of the day to stop the sync. An integer between 0 and 23, with 0 = '12 AM', 1 = '1 AM', ... 23 = '11 PM'.

auto_cache_allowed.description: If true, auto cache will be enabled for the entire volume. When enabled, auto cache may be enabled at a folder level.

auto_cache_min_file_size.description: Auto Cache Minimum File Size in bytes. When Auto Cache is enabled, only files greater than or equal to the specified size will be automatically brought into cache.

days.description: Days of the week to allow snapshots to occur.

allday.description: If true, will allow snapshots all day.

start.description: Hour of the day to start allowing snapshots. An integer between 0 and 23, with 0 = '12 AM', 1 = '1 AM', ... 23 = '11 PM'.

stop.description: Hour of the day to stop allowing snapshots. An integer between 0 and 23, with 0 = '12 AM', 1 = '1 AM', ... 23 = '11 PM'.

snapshot_access.description: If true, the snapshot directory is accessible.

enabled.description: If true, the file alert service is enabled.

items.description: Name pattern for files or directories. The wildcard character "*" is used to represent multiple possible characters. For example, "*.mp3" will cause an alert on all files with the mp3 extension.

enabled.description: If true, file system auditing is enabled for the volume.

create.description: If true, will log file, directory, and link creation operations.

delete.description: If true, will log file and directory delete operations.

rename.description: If true, will log file and directory rename operations.

close.description: If true, will log file close operations.

security.description: If true, will log file and directory ownership and permission changes.

metadata.description: If true, will log changes to update time and extended attributes.

write.description: If true, will log file write and truncate operations.

read.description: If true, will log file and directory read operations.

events.description: Various file system events that can be audited.

write_audit_logs.description: If true, audit logs will be wrote to the .nasuni directory for this volume.

prune_audit_logs.description: If true, audit logs older than the specified number of days will be deleted. The number of days can be specified by the 'days_to_keep' property.

days_to_keep.description: Number of days to keep audit logs. A value of 0 will disable pruning of audit logs.

exclude_by_default.description: Do not audit operations for any path not matching an entry in the include list (see 'include_patterns').

include_takes_priority.description: Operations on items matching an entry in the include list will always be included even if matching an entry in the exclude list (see 'exclude_patterns').

include_patterns.description: List of path patterns to include in the audit logs.

items.description: Path to include in the audit logs. The path can use the glob syntax to match a pattern such as */example*/*.

exclude_patterns.description: List of path patterns to exclude from the audit logs.

items.description: Path to exclude from the audit logs. The path can use the glob syntax to match a pattern such as */example*/*.

accessible_data.description: Number of bytes of data that are accessible via this volume.

data_not_yet_protected.description: Number of bytes of data that have not been protected.

first_snapshot.description: Datetime of the first snapshot that occurred on the volume.

last_snapshot.description: Datetime of the last snapshot that occurred on the volume.

last_snapshot_start.description: Datetime of the start of the last snapshot.

last_snapshot_end.description: Datetime of the end of the last snapshot.

last_snapshot_version.description: The version number of the last snapshot that occurred.

snapshot_status.description:
Current snapshot status. Possible values:

* 'idle' - No snapshots are in progress.
* 'pending' - A snapshot is pending and will be performed soon.
* 'in_progress' - A snapshot is in progress.

snapshot_percent.description: If a snapshot is 'in_progress', this will show the percentage that it is complete.

ftp_dir_count.description: Number of FTP directories accessible via this volume.

export_count.description: Number of Exports accessible via this volume.

share_count.description: Number of Shares accessible via this volume.

status.description: Volume status for a particular Filer.

links.description: Links to related resources, collections, and actions.

ExportAccessModeField.description:
Controls what User IDs are allowed when a client writes
to the exported directory. Possible values:

* 'root_squash' - Normal Users Permitted
* 'no_root_squash' - All Users Permitted
* 'all_squash' - Anonymize All Users

ExportHostSpecField.description: Hostname, IP address with optional netmask, or @-prefixed netgroup names allowed to access the export. If blank, all hosts on your network can access the export. Hostnames may contain the * character as a wildcard.

ExportPerfModeField.description:
Controls the method in which the NFS server replies to clients.
Changing this may impact the safety of data if the Nasuni Filer is shut down abnormally!
Possible values:

* 'sync' - Default
* 'no_wdelay' - No Write Delay
* 'async' - Asynchronous Replies

ExportReadOnlyField.description: If true, files and directories cannot be changed on the exported directory.

ExportSecOptionsField.description: Security options in use by the exported directory. Multiple options may be applied, but they cannot be repeated.

items.description:
Possible values:

* 'sys' - Traditional
* 'krb5' - Authentication
* 'krb5i' - Integrity Protection
* 'krb5p' - Privacy Protection

paging_limit.name: limit
paging_limit.description: The maximum number of objects to return

paging_offset.name: offset
paging_offset.description: The index of the first object to return

AuthToken.description:
This header is required to make authenticated requests. The value format is:

Token [your_auth_token]
AuthToken.name: Authorization
